transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good evening, thank you for calling S-Net Entertainment and TV Support. My name is Chloe speaking. Who do I have the pleasure of speaking with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Chloe, my name is Violetta Kowalski. My Netflix and Disney+ entertainment bundle activation token expired before I could link my account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, I am so sorry about that, Violetta! I completely understand how disappointing it is when you sit down to watch your shows and the bundle link won't work.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, yes, I promised my kids we would watch a movie together tonight and instead I'm stuck staring at an error screen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your Netflix and Disney+ entertainment bundle activation token expired before you could link your account. Let's get you verified first so I can fix that right away—could you confirm your postcode, first line of your address, and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, it's 14 Sycamore Avenue, Guildford, GU1 3RX, and my four-digit security PIN is 3185.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Violetta, I have verified 14 Sycamore Avenue, GU1 3RX and PIN 3185 on your S-Net Superfast & Entertainment profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, I added the Ultimate Entertainment Bolt-On last week when I upgraded my broadband package.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me ask a few diagnostic questions so we make sure the new entitlement links cleanly. First, what exact error code or message appears when you tap the activation link?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It opens a page on the S-Net partner portal that says 'Error ENT-410: Activation Token Expired – Valid for 72 Hours Only'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Error ENT-410 confirms the initial 72-hour provisioning token timed out in our Partner Entitlement Gateway while your broadband upgrade was completing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes sense because I received the welcome text while I was away in Krakow visiting my parents and didn't click it until this evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ah, I hope you had a lovely trip visiting your family in Krakow! Did you get good weather while you were over in Poland?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It was crisp and sunny every day, thank you, we had a wonderful time walking around the old town square.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That sounds gorgeous! Now for my second diagnostic question: do you already have existing standalone Netflix or Disney+ accounts, or are you creating brand-new ones?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I already have both under my personal email, which is violetta.kowalski88@gmail.com—that's v-i-o-l-e-t-t-a dot k-o-w-a-l-s-k-i 88 at gmail dot com.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got that noted, and did you already cancel the direct card billing on those existing accounts, or are they still active on your Visa or Mastercard?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: They are both still active on my debit card right now because the S-Net guide said linking the token automatically pauses direct card billing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is completely right, Violetta—once the S-Net billing bridge links to your login, Netflix and Disney+ automatically switch payment method to 'Billed via S-Net' without losing your watch history or profiles.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh good, my kids would never forgive me if their Disney+ watchlists disappeared!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We definitely won't let their watchlists vanish! Third diagnostic question: which device and browser are you using to open the activation portal right now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm on my iPad Air using Safari, and I noticed earlier that Safari had Content Blockers turned on, though I switched them off ten minutes ago.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And are you connected to your home S-Net Wi-Fi network on that iPad Air right now, or using mobile data or a VPN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm connected directly to our home S-Net Wi-Fi with no VPN turned on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Being on your home S-Net Wi-Fi with Safari Content Blockers off is ideal because strict cross-site tracking prevention can sometimes block the redirect back from Netflix to S-Net.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why didn't the 'Resend Activation Link' button inside my MyS-Net dashboard work when I tapped it five minutes ago?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When a token hits Error ENT-410 in the Partner Entitlement Gateway, the self-service 'Resend' button just re-emails the same expired token ID unless an agent purges the stuck session first.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, I see! That explains why the second link I requested gave me the exact same ENT-410 screen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am going to take care of purging both stuck entitlement tokens in the backend gateway and generating a fresh 72-hour activation pair for you right now, Violetta.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, Chloe, how long does that take to reset?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just about a minute. Please bear with me while I revoke token batch ENT-88219 in the Partner Entitlement Gateway and generate fresh activation keys.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, take your time, I'll wait right here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Violetta! I have purged the expired ENT-410 session records for both your Netflix Standard and Disney+ Standard subscriptions.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Awesome! Were you able to generate the brand-new activation tokens on the system?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the Partner Entitlement Gateway has just issued fresh token reference PEG-550912 for Netflix and PEG-550913 for Disney+.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And both of those are ready to link right now on my iPad?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, they are live and unlocked in the billing bridge right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, how do I open them on my iPad?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can push both activation links straight out to you from my console by SMS and email so you can tap them immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, sending them over now would be brilliant so we can test them while you're still on the phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I click send on the gateway dispatch, let me verify that your mobile number ending in 0942 is beside you for the SMS backup link.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my mobile ending in 0942 is sitting right next to my iPad on the coffee table.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, I have queued the SMS link to your 0942 mobile number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And can you send the email version as well since it's easier to tap straight from the mail app on my iPad?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course, Violetta! And what email address would you like me to send the new activation token to?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Chloe, I literally spelled my email address out letter by letter for you a few minutes ago—it's violetta.kowalski88@gmail.com!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, I am so sorry about that, Violetta! You did spell out violetta.kowalski88@gmail.com earlier when we talked about your existing logins—let me dispatch the email to that address right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right, let me check my Gmail inbox on my iPad... okay, the email from S-Net Entertainment Hub just arrived!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful! Let's stay on the line together while you tap the first button—'Activate Netflix on S-Net'—so we can confirm it links properly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I'm tapping 'Activate Netflix on S-Net' now... it opened the Netflix sign-in page with the S-Net partner banner at the top.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That partner banner means token PEG-550912 authenticated cleanly! Go ahead and sign in with your existing Netflix password.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Signing in now... and it says 'Success! Your Netflix Standard membership is now included with your S-Net Entertainment Bundle'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic! And if you tap 'View Account Membership Details' on that screen, what does it show under Billing & Payment?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says 'Billed through S-Net – Next card charge paused', and all four of our family profiles are still right there!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is one down! Now let's pop back to the S-Net email on your iPad and tap the second button, 'Activate Disney+ on S-Net'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, going back to Gmail and tapping the Disney+ activation button now... it's redirecting to the Disney+ partner linking page.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, log in with the same email and password and let me know what status message comes up on your screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hold on, it's loading... yes! It says 'Your Disney+ subscription is now linked and managed by S-Net'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me refresh my Partner Entitlement Gateway screen here... yes, both PEG-550912 and PEG-550913 have flipped from 'Pending Token' to 'Active & Linked to S-Net Billing'!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check my MyS-Net dashboard page too... yes, both Netflix and Disney+ now have green ticks and say 'Linked to S-Net Billing'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And will you also receive an email from Netflix and Disney+ confirming that your direct Visa debit card billing has been paused?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Actually, two automated emails from Netflix and Disney+ just landed in my Gmail inbox confirming billing has switched to S-Net!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And just so there are no billing surprises, Violetta, because your bundle wasn't linked during the first six days of your upgrade, I have applied a five-pound pro-rata credit to your next S-Net bill.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, thank you so much, Chloe, I didn't even expect a credit for those six days!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You shouldn't pay for days before the bundle was linked! That five-pound credit is already sitting on your next bill summary.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's really thoughtful of you. So we are completely good to start our family movie night on the smart TV now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are 100 percent ready to go, Violetta—your smart TV apps are already logged into those same accounts, and the billing is now covered by S-Net.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Brilliant, the kids are going to be thrilled we can finally put the movie on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What movie have the kids picked out for tonight's family movie night?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We're watching Inside Out 2 on Disney+ with a big bowl of popcorn!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, Inside Out 2 is such a fun film, you will all love it! Can I confirm everything with your Netflix and Disney+ bundle is completely resolved for you this evening?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, both accounts are linked and working properly now, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else at all I can help you with on your S-Net broadband or TV package tonight, Violetta?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything, thank you Chloe.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Violetta, and if you have a quick moment after we finish, there will be a short survey on my service tonight. Enjoy your movie!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks Chloe, goodnight!
